subject: Proposal: temporary net-term bridge & VAT instalment agreement for Q3 consumption
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@omniva.co.uk>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@omniva.co.uk
Date: 2026-11-01T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Net terms for Q3 consumption - pilot proposal

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We expect a usage bump in Q3 as several clinics come on board and would like to propose a short-term net-term arrangement to smooth cashflow while we scale. Specifically: can Omniva move to Net45 for the next three monthly invoices (Nov/Dec/Jan) with a temporary credit buffer of GBP 125,000?

We can provide VAT registration details for reverse-charge where applicable. Also happy to put a purchase order in place. Do you have a process checklist (documents you need) so we can turn this around quickly?

Attached: Omniva_VAT_certificate.pdf (VAT registration summary).

Thanks,
Raj
Raj Patel
Head of Finance, Omniva Health
raj.patel@omniva.co.uk
+44 20 7946 1023
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@omniva.co.uk>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Net terms for Q3 consumption - pilot proposal

Hi Raj — appreciate the quick follow-up and the VAT doc. Happy to do a short pilot but want to lock a couple of protections on our side given the uplift. Proposed terms below:

- Pilot duration: next 3 invoices (Nov/Dec/Jan).
- Payment term: Net45 for all three invoices.
- Temporary credit buffer: GBP 125,000 (covers expected peak).
- Holdback: 10% of each invoice will be retained until we receive validated VAT documentation for reverse-charge (or confirmation of local VAT handling) — aim to release within 30 days of receipt.
- PO required prior to first invoice to bind terms.
- If VAT reverse-charge applies, we need the registration number + a PDF of the certificate (we received a summary; full cert preferred).

Operational asks: please attach a PO and the company registration number. We'll run the credit checklist (Laura cc'd) and, assuming standard checks, Ben (cc) will approve the buffer for the pilot. I will also create the HubSpot deal (HS-5821) and send a DocuSign for the Net45 pilot amendment.

If that sounds acceptable I will: 1) request credit team sign-off, 2) send the DocuSign amendment, and 3) confirm invoice schedule (monthly, sent on the 1st of each month).

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — EMEA, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@omniva.co.uk>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Net terms for Q3 consumption - pilot proposal

Markus / Raj — looping in the finance intake here. To progress we need the completed credit application and two months of bank/trading reference (can be a single consolidated PDF).

I've attached our "credit_application_form.xlsx" — Raj, if you can fill this and attach a bank reference we can fast-track to sign-off. Once Ben approves the buffer I'll notify Markus and Legal will prepare the amendment.

Documents required (minimum):
- Completed credit application (attached)
- Company registration number and VAT certificate (PDF)
- Bank/trading reference or recent statement (redacted OK)
- Purchase order referencing HS-5821

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
redwood.ai
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@omniva.co.uk>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Net terms for Q3 consumption - pilot proposal

Thanks Markus / Laura — understood and agreed. Attaching the full VAT certificate (omniva_vat_cert.pdf) and the PO (PO-OMV-1126) as separate emails to follow within the hour. We'll also complete the credit application and provide a bank reference from Lloyds.

Two quick clarifications before I sign the DocuSign:
1) Will the 10% holdback be listed on the invoice line as "retention" so our AR team knows the gross/gross-minus-retention amounts?
2) If Omniva provides a validated VAT reverse-charge statement, can the holdback be released within 14 days (rather than 30)?

If you confirm those points I'll proceed with the paperwork and expect to execute the amendment today.

Best,
Raj
